douyinAccounts.title: Douyin Accounts
douyinAccounts.description: Extension-first Douyin capture from the operator's real Chrome or Edge tab.
douyinAccounts.pageDescription: Install the capture extension, open Douyin in your real browser session, log in or solve challenges manually, then detect and capture the current tab into the canonical intake pipeline.
douyinAccounts.extensionDescription: Use your normal Chrome or Edge Douyin session. The extension reads only the visible current tab, then sends safe profile/video payloads to the local API for canonical ingest.
douyinAccounts.extensionGuideInstall: Build and load the unpacked extension from apps/extension-douyin-capture/dist in Chrome or Edge.
douyinAccounts.extensionGuideBrowse: Open Douyin in your real browser, log in, solve any challenge manually, and navigate to the target profile, feed, or video page.
douyinAccounts.extensionGuideDetect: Click Detect current page in the extension popup to classify the active tab before importing.
douyinAccounts.extensionGuideCapture: Click Capture current page in the extension popup. Scroll or load more manually, then capture again to import additional visible videos.
douyinAccounts.extensionPrivacyNote: The extension must not export cookies, auth tokens, passwords, local storage, session storage, or browser profile paths.
douyinAccounts.browserDescription: Legacy Playwright-managed browser controls remain available only for debugging stuck accounts or old validation flows. Prefer the Chrome/Edge extension for new Douyin collection.
douyinAccounts.browserLegacyControlsDescription: Use only when troubleshooting old account validation or runtime state; this is no longer the primary collection path.
douyinAccounts.browserProfileOpened: Browser profile opened. Log in or solve challenges there, then navigate to the target Douyin profile before detecting or capturing.
douyinAccounts.browserStarted: Browser profile opened. Complete login in the Douyin window.
douyinAccounts.browserPollError: Failed to refresh browser runtime status

douyinAccounts.browserTimeoutHelp: The browser profile setup timed out before login or validation completed. Reopen the saved profile or reset runtime state if it is stuck.
douyinAccounts.troubleshootingDescription: Only use these controls when the local browser runtime is stuck or recovering from a failed setup.

douyinAccounts.resetConnectNothing: No stuck browser runtime attempts needed reset.
douyinAccounts.resetConnectError: Failed to reset browser runtime state
douyinAccounts.resetConnectHelp: Use reset only if local browser runtime is stuck. Saved Douyin accounts are not deleted.
douyinAccounts.validationRetryPassed: Validation retry passed. Douyin account is connected.
douyinAccounts.validationRetryFinished: Validation retry finished. Check the runtime status below.

douyinAccounts.stabilizingAuthHelp: Douyin login is stabilizing. The browser remains open for validation.

douyinAccounts.postLoginBlockedRetryHelp: Login was detected, but the first post-login check looked blocked or too early. Keep the browser open and retry validation before reopening.
douyinAccounts.browserRuntimeUnavailableHelp: Local browser runtime is unavailable. Install Playwright runtime, then reopen the saved browser profile.
douyinAccounts.browserClosedHelp: The browser window closed before login completed. Reopen the saved browser profile.
douyinAccounts.importDescription: Legacy troubleshooting fallback only. Browser profiles are the primary path for Intake discovery. Do not paste passwords.
douyinAccounts.sessionCookieHelp: The raw cookie is saved only on the API side and is never echoed back.
douyinAccounts.makeDefaultHelp: Use this account when Intake does not specify one.
douyinAccounts.guidanceDescription: Keep collection explicit: real browser tab, extension payload, canonical ingest.
douyinAccounts.guideInstallExtension: Install or reload the Chrome/Edge extension from the local extension build.
douyinAccounts.guideImport: Legacy only: open the reusable local browser profile for the account.
douyinAccounts.guideValidate: In your real browser, log in to Douyin, solve visible challenges, and navigate manually to the target page.
douyinAccounts.guideDetect: Click Detect current page in the extension popup to classify only the active real browser tab.
douyinAccounts.guideCapture: Click Capture current page in the extension popup after the profile/feed is visible. Scroll or load more manually, then capture again to import more videos.
douyinAccounts.guideSelect: Use imported candidates from the review board and downstream workflow.
